episodeTitle.en: Molly Graham: The grief, burnout, and opportunity hiding inside the AI transition
episodeTitle.zh: Molly Graham：AI 转型中的失落、倦怠与潜藏的机会

guestBioOfficial.zh: Molly Graham 曾在 Google、Facebook、Quip 和陈扎克伯格基金会担任管理职务。录制时她经营管理者社区 Glue Club，并主持 TED 的 WorkLife。她长期陪伴快速成长团队里的个人处理职责变化和身份转换。
guestBioOfficial.en: Molly has held leadership roles at Google, Facebook, Quip, and the Chan Zuckerberg Initiative. She runs Glue Club and hosts TED’s WorkLife, drawing on years of helping people navigate changes in organizational roles and identity.

title.en: Molly Graham: The grief, burnout, and opportunity hiding inside the AI transition
title.zh: Molly Graham：AI 转型中的失落、倦怠与潜藏的机会

summary.zh: Molly 曾鼓励人们在公司成长时「交出自己的乐高积木」，把职责让给别人。AI 转型让这句建议变难了：如果看不见下一个角色，放手意味着什么？她讨论了这种失落，也把一个具体责任交还给管理者：把优秀工作的新标准示范给团队看。
summary.en: Molly revisits her advice to give away responsibilities as a company grows. When AI makes the next role hard to see, letting go can feel like a loss. She explores that fear and what managers can do to make expectations clearer.

insights.title: 放手之前，先听听对方怕失去什么
insights.detail: 过去交出职责通常意味着接手更大的挑战。现在有人担心另一边根本没有工作，原来的职业建议自然会引发不同反应。
insights.detailEn: Giving up a responsibility feels different when someone cannot see a job on the other side of the transition.
insights.titleEn: Ask what the person stands to lose

insights.title: 把「放下旧事」背后的假设说出来
insights.detail: 建议别人腾出空间，其实假设了两件事：旧工作值得放下，前面也会有新机会。Molly 会把这两个假设分别拿出来讨论。
insights.detailEn: Molly separates two assumptions in her old advice: that letting go is worthwhile and that a new opportunity will actually follow.
insights.titleEn: Examine the assumptions behind letting go

insights.title: 管理者要示范何时该由人负责
insights.detail: 哪些工作可以交给 AI，怎样才算完成得好，需要领导者用自己的选择来说明。只下达效率要求，很难让团队理解质量底线。
insights.detailEn: Leaders can model which work to delegate and what good work looks like, making accountability concrete for the team.

related.reason: 对照她上一次受访时的职业成长建议，看哪些前提发生了变化。
related.reasonEn: Revisit her earlier career advice and compare the assumptions behind it.
